settings.heading: PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
settings.content:
• Midweight Construction
    Ideal thickness for year-round wear. Enough warmth for winter mornings, enough breathability for hot days in steel caps.
  • Merino Wool Performance
    Naturally insulating, moisture-wicking, and odour-resistant—merino adapts to your body and environment, keeping your feet dry, fresh, and blister-free.
  • Reinforced Heel, Toe & Sole
    High-stress zones are reinforced with extra yarn for long-lasting durability where it matters most.
  • All-Day Comfort Fit
    Ribbed arch support and strategic cushioning reduce foot fatigue and stop slipping inside your boots.
  • Odour Control
    Natural antimicrobial properties mean less stink after long days on the tools.
  • Breathable & Thermoregulating
    Keeps you warm without overheating, and cool without compromising protection.
  • Australian Made
    Designed, tested, and manufactured right here in Australia to handle our harshest conditions. You're not just buying socks—you’re supporting local jobs and industry.

settings.heading: MATERIALS & CARE
settings.content:
Machine wash in cold water on gentle cycle with socks inside-out. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low or hang dry. Do not dry clean.

Materials: 80% Merino Wool 18% Nylon 2% Spandex

settings.heading: All-Day Comfort Starts at Your Feet
settings.text: A dodgy pair of socks can be felt all day in work boots. That’s why we craft our socks using a dense, durable knit designed to handle tough conditions. Made with just three key materials: Merino Wool, Nylon, and Lycra® . They’re built for performance across any environment. Merino wool’s natural structure regulates temperature while allowing moisture to escape, keeping your feet dry, warm, and breathable. No more swampy toes or frozen feet. Just comfort that works as hard as you do.

settings.heading: True-Blue Lifetime Guarantee

settings.text: If our socks don’t live up to your standards for comfort, durability, or fit, we’ll replace them. No hassle.
